**[`hooks/log_payload.js`](hooks/log_payload.js)** — key behaviour:
- Reads stdin with a 1-second timeout using a `Promise` + `setTimeout` that destroys the stream if it doesn't close in time.
- Filters `process.env` to only include keys starting with `BOB_`, `HOOK_`, or `CLAUDE_` for the `env` field; all key names (sorted, no values) go into `envKeys`.
- Output path is `SPIKE_OUT_DIR` env var or `<__dirname>/../out/`; directory is created with `mkdirSync({ recursive: true })`.
- File name is `<event>-<Date.now()>-<pid>.json`.
- Always prints `SPIKE-MARKER <event> <timestamp>` and exits 0; write errors go to stderr only.

**[`.bob/custom_modes.yaml`](.bob/custom_modes.yaml)** — three modes:
| slug | groups | note |
|---|---|---|
| `spike-coder` | read, edit, execute, mcp | MCP ping-on-block instruction |
| `spike-cmd-typo` | read, **command** | intentional invalid group (negative control) |
| `spike-readonly` | read, mcp | Indonesian customInstructions |
